An Acknowledgement of Canadians

We acknowledge and thank all the people who have built Canada and continue to build it every day.

We recognize the workers, tradespeople, farmers, business owners, entrepreneurs, caregivers, volunteers, public servants, and families who contribute to our communities.

We acknowledge the millions of Canadians who work hard, pay their taxes, raise their families, create jobs, build our homes and infrastructure, and contribute to the society we all share.

Canada was built through the hard work, sacrifices, and contributions of generations of people, and it continues to depend on the same spirit today.

We recognize and appreciate everyone who contributes to making Canada a better place for the generations that follow.
